summary.text: Darren Deacon is the Republican candidate for Alaska State Senate District S in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the August 18 nonpartisan primary.
He was previously a candidate for the Alaska House of Representatives in 2018 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Darren Deacon ran in the 2018 general election for Alaska House of Representatives District 38 and lost to incumbent Tiffany Zulkosky (D), 44.1 percent to 55.6 percent.
In 2024 he advanced from the primary for House District 37 and lost the general election to incumbent Bryce Edgmon.
